name: Thrizer vs Mentaya
title: Thrizer vs Mentaya: Out-of-Network Billing for Therapists Compared
description: Compare Thrizer and Mentaya - two leading out-of-network claims submission platforms for therapists. See differences in pricing, reimbursement fronting, and client fees.

summary.bottom_line: Both Thrizer and Mentaya are free for therapists and eliminate superbills for out-of-network clients. The key difference is Thrizer fronts reimbursements so clients pay copay-like amounts immediately, while Mentaya submits claims without fronting. Mentaya has a higher client fee (5%) but offers a 100% refund guarantee and EHR integrations.

rows.entity_b: Free (no processing fee if using own payment)

sections.heading: Thrizer vs Mentaya: Overview
sections.content: Thrizer and Mentaya both solve the same problem: helping out-of-network therapists submit insurance claims without superbills. Both are free for therapists and handle claims submission, denial management, and deductible tracking automatically. The fundamental difference is in how reimbursements work: Thrizer fronts the expected reimbursement so clients pay a copay-like amount at the time of service, while Mentaya submits claims and clients receive reimbursement later.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Both platforms are free for therapists with different client fee structures. Thrizer charges clients $1.50 per claim plus 1% of the reimbursement amount. Mentaya charges clients 5% of reimbursement. For a $200 session with $160 reimbursement: Thrizer client fee = $3.10; Mentaya client fee = $8.00. Thrizer appears cheaper for clients, but Mentaya offers a 100% refund guarantee if claims fail. Both allow therapists to absorb client fees as a practice perk.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Thrizer's standout feature is reimbursement fronting: after meeting their deductible, clients pay only a copay-like amount while therapists receive their full rate upfront. This can be a significant selling point for client retention. Mentaya doesn't front reimbursements but offers SimplePractice and Jane App integrations, which Thrizer lacks. Both offer free instant OON benefits calculators, though Mentaya charges for its calculator as an add-on.

sections.heading: Which Platform for Which Practice?
sections.content: Thrizer is ideal for therapists who want to offer copay-like pricing to make OON therapy more affordable at the point of service. Mentaya is better for practices that already use SimplePractice or Jane and want seamless integration, or those who value the 100% refund guarantee. Both eliminate the burden of superbills and handle the complexity of OON claims.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on what matters most to your practice:

recommendations.when: You want clients to pay copay-like amounts at time of service, value reimbursement fronting as a competitive advantage, or want the free benefits calculator
You use SimplePractice or Jane and want integration, value the 100% refund guarantee, or prefer to use your own payment processor
You're an out-of-network therapist wanting to eliminate superbills and simplify client reimbursement - both are solid choices

faqs.q: Which is cheaper for clients: Thrizer or Mentaya?
faqs.a: Thrizer is typically cheaper. For a $200 session with $160 reimbursement, Thrizer charges $3.10 ($1.50 + 1% of $160) while Mentaya charges $8.00 (5% of $160). However, Mentaya offers a 100% refund guarantee if claims fail.

faqs.q: What is reimbursement fronting and why does it matter?
faqs.a: Reimbursement fronting (offered by Thrizer) means the platform advances the expected insurance reimbursement to you, so clients pay only a copay-like amount at the time of session. This makes OON therapy more affordable at the point of service, potentially improving client retention.

faqs.q: Do I need to switch payment processors to use these platforms?
faqs.a: Thrizer has built-in payment processing (3% fee). Mentaya can work with your existing payment setup or optionally add Stripe (2.9% + 30¢). You don't need to change your current workflow with Mentaya.

faqs.q: Can I use Thrizer or Mentaya with SimplePractice?
faqs.a: Mentaya has native SimplePractice integration. Thrizer does not currently integrate with any EHRs, so you'd manage it separately from your practice management system.
